title: Frontend: Contact Form
businessContext: Build and verify the core behavior behind Contact Form. This independently authored exercise has a bounded, explicit contract. Injected clock, network, random, or worker models are identified in the contract; they do not claim production service guarantees.
problemStatement: Export App. Validate a trimmed Name (nonempty), Email (one basic non-whitespace local@domain.tld form), and Message (at least 10 trimmed characters). Return trimmed {name,email,message}, lowercasing email. Any failure shows Invalid contact details; this tests client form logic, not actual email delivery. Render controlled labelled inputs with these exact names: Name, Email, Message. A Calculate submit button computes the result. Render JSON.stringify(result) in [data-testid="result"]. Validation failure clears result and shows the documented message in [data-testid="error"].
constraints: Export default App. Only react and react/jsx-runtime imports are supported. The DOM contract and supplied props define the exercise.
Preserve identity, ordering, boundary behavior, and error messages stated in the contract. Passing fixtures verifies this contract, not every production concern.
candidateTasks: Implement the documented behavior without hard-coding fixture answers.
Run the full suite, investigate boundary failures, and explain the follow-up variation.
hints: Write down the state or algorithmic invariant, and trace the smallest boundary case before coding.
Keep raw fields in state and validate on a documented boundary such as blur or submit.
alternativeApproaches: Add server field errors without erasing newer edits made while a request was in flight.
commonMistakes: Ignoring contract boundaries such as: Required fields; malformed email; whitespace-only message.
Treating a local deterministic model as proof of durable storage, authorization, distributed coordination, or physical-world guarantees.
